From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cohort Connect: Inference Playbook — invite + ops checklist

Hi Ana and Devon,

Thanks again for the quick intro call this week — we heard your goals for controlled rollout and cost predictability and think the upcoming cohort session will be a good fit. We're running a small group "Cohort Connect: Inference Playbook" next week that walks through: model routing, cost-aware batching, and a real-world rollout checklist. It's intentionally short (45 min + 15 Q&A) and geared toward engineering + platform leads.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Jun 29, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Jun 30, 12:00–12:45
- Thu Jul 1, 08:30–09:15

Can you confirm which slot works for you and whether you'd like a short tech deep-dive after the cohort (20–30 min)? If helpful, I'll send a calendar invite and a one-page mutual action plan to align outcomes.

Agenda draft attached.

Thanks,
David

--
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: 2027-06-25-inference-cohort-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:23:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Cohort Connect: Inference Playbook — invite + ops checklist

Hi David,

Appreciate the invite. Tue Jun 29 at 10:00 PT would work best for our core team (me + our platform lead, Devon). We'd like the 20–30 min technical deep-dive after the cohort — specifically around cache strategies and KV cache persistence across deployments.

One ask: can you include a short checklist for procurement/security items we should surface to our infra team ahead of time (SOC2 evidence, network ports, KMS integration)? That'll speed things up on our side.

Thanks,
Ana
